tasks.title: Implement task selector with priority and dependency resolution

acceptance_criteria.title: Selection by priority
acceptance_criteria.given: 3 tasks 'A faire': T1 (P2), T2 (P0), T3 (P1)
acceptance_criteria.then: Returns T2 (P0 is highest priority)

acceptance_criteria.title: Dependency respect
acceptance_criteria.given: T1 (P0) depends on T2 (P1, 'A faire') via 'Bloque par'
acceptance_criteria.then: T2 is selected (T1 is blocked by unfinished T2)

acceptance_criteria.title: Circular dependency detection
acceptance_criteria.given: T1 depends on T2, T2 depends on T1 (circular)
acceptance_criteria.then: Both are marked 'Bloque' and neither is selected

acceptance_criteria.title: Story ID tiebreaker
acceptance_criteria.given: T1 (P1, Story ID 'US-003') and T2 (P1, Story ID 'US-001')
acceptance_criteria.when: select_next_task(tasks) is called with equal priority tasks
acceptance_criteria.then: T2 is selected (US-001 < US-003)
